channel.title: The daily tape · compute.world
channel.description: The buyers and the builders agree there is not enough compute. The disagreement is over who pays for it. Alphabet CEO Sundar Pichai said this week that everyone is short and that a customer asking Google for capacity in 2027 is incredibly difficult to serve. Jensen Huang told CNBC in Berlin that the demand for capital is much greater than the availability of capital, and put a 1 GW data center at about $50 billion. Markets are pricing that gap into the neoclouds: CoreWeave fell 10% on 22 October after Bernstein cut its target to $51 from $74, with Nebius down 7%, IREN 8% and Applied Digital 9%, and CoreWeave's unsecured bonds yield about 15%. Tesla went the other way and cut its 2026 capex outlook to about $20 billion from more than $25 billion. On the public tape, Crusoe cut its HGX B300 on-demand list to $8.96 from $9.90, down 9.5%, two days after its CEO said rental prices are rising. Everything else confirmed.

item.title: Compute brief - 23 October 2026
item.description: The buyers and the builders agree there is not enough compute. The disagreement is over who pays for it. Alphabet CEO Sundar Pichai said this week that everyone is short and that a customer asking Google for capacity in 2027 is incredibly difficult to serve. Jensen Huang told CNBC in Berlin that the demand for capital is much greater than the availability of capital, and put a 1 GW data center at about $50 billion. Markets are pricing that gap into the neoclouds: CoreWeave fell 10% on 22 October after Bernstein cut its target to $51 from $74, with Nebius down 7%, IREN 8% and Applied Digital 9%, and CoreWeave's unsecured bonds yield about 15%. Tesla went the other way and cut its 2026 capex outlook to about $20 billion from more than $25 billion. On the public tape, Crusoe cut its HGX B300 on-demand list to $8.96 from $9.90, down 9.5%, two days after its CEO said rental prices are rising. Everything else confirmed. Countries: Kazakhstan: Firebird signs an investment agreement with the government and holds a US export license for 45,000 Grace Blackwell GPUs; phase one with Kazakhtelecom at Data Center Valley targets Q3 2027, about 500 MW potential with phase two (Wire, 23 Oct). United States: Loudoun supervisors approve a preliminary deal under which Amazon drops data centers on its GW campus site, gives the county 25 acres worth about $65 million and $5 million for housing (Wire, 20 Oct). Pause on new data center applications deferred to 17 Nov. China: Reuters: ByteDance, Alibaba and Tencent order more than 3 million RTX PRO 5500 cards worth over $35 billion; NVIDIA may fill only 5% to 10% (Wire, 20 Oct; single source). Spain: IREN secures grid power and the civil works license for a planned 300 MW AI campus in Badajoz, operations targeted for 2028 (Wire, 21 Oct).
